speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I need to evaluate your skin condition, particularly any lesions that might have oncologic implications. Can you describe the specific changes you are noticing in your skin, such as new growths, sores that won't heal, or changes in existing moles?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC) of the penis and finger.

The history of smoking, immunosuppression (if applicable), and non-healing lesions despite treatment for syphilis and eczema is highly suspicious for malignancy. I need to confirm the extent of the lesions and rule out deep invasion or metastasis.

REQUEST TEST: Biopsy of penile and digital lesions.
REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) and Comprehensive Metabolic Panel.
